payload.summary: Resolved fail-closed policy, adjudication, quorum, recovery-budget, and routing-contract gaps found by two independent plan analyses. The frozen contracts now cover complete consensus and logical-attempt boundaries, and the work-package DAG isolates attempt, routing, transport, convergence, and integration ownership.
completed_work: Added modified convergence, quorum-reporting, and checkpoint-layout requirements.
Expanded the consensus contract with stable groups, policy counts, quorum, and trusted adjudication records.
Replaced the attempt contract with a bounded logical-request chain and strict success/failure invariants.
Specified deterministic matching limits, replacement selection, routing precedence, and thinking translation.
Reworked tasks and work packages to cover shared helpers and compatibility callers without parallel file overlap.
Passed strict OpenSpec, Draft 2020-12 contract, work-package DAG, scope-overlap, lock-overlap, and diff checks.

decisions.title: Use stable adjudication ledger identities
decisions.rationale: Adjudications may carry across rounds only when the versioned group identifier and exact concern fingerprints still match.

decisions.title: Bound one logical review request explicitly
decisions.rationale: One corrective attempt, deduplicated same-provider fallbacks, a monotonic deadline, and at most one undispatched replacement prevent recursive cost and quorum inflation.

decisions.title: Make compatibility aliases exact
decisions.rationale: unconfirmed_count equals provisional_count and blocking_count equals the conservative effective-blocking union.

decisions.title: Split dispatcher concerns into staged packages
decisions.rationale: Transport-neutral attempt/quorum and routing helpers can be tested independently before adapter and caller integration.

next_steps: Run the independently routed PLAN_REVIEW phase against the refined revision-2 contracts.
If review converges, implement the six-package DAG from the managed feature worktree.

relevant_files.description: resolved plan-quality findings and readiness evidence
